description: Definition of Done checklist that every task must satisfy before marking as complete.

checklist.item: Code has been peer-reviewed and approved by at least one team member
No critical or high SonarQube/linting issues remaining
Unit tests written and passing with minimum 80% coverage for new code
Integration tests passing in CI pipeline
QA engineer has verified acceptance criteria on staging environment
Security review completed and signed off for security-sensitive tasks
No secrets, credentials, or API keys committed to source code
Architecture review completed for tasks with system-wide impact
API documentation updated if endpoints were added or changed
README or runbook updated if deployment or operations changed
Feature deployed to staging environment and smoke-tested
Rollback plan documented and tested for critical deployments
Compliance evidence attached for GDPR, PCI, HIPAA, or SOX tasks
AI guardrails, fallback behavior, and safety controls documented and tested
